notes.title: Translations Announcements!
notes.content:
Hey peeps!

We just wanted to drop a quick note that Stifled will be shipping with few more languages on-top of English thanks to the following partners and friends!

[list]
    [*]Português Brasileiro -[url=https://www.facebook.com/blasterlizardcompany/]BlasterLizard Co.[/url] 
    [*]Simplified Chinese - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/AnJetCat/]AnJetCat[/url]
    [*]Traditional Chinese - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/AnJetCat/]AnJetCat[/url]
[/list]

So, if you'd like to see Stifled in your language please drop justin@gattaigames.com an email*!

*Access to the game and translation files will be subject to our discretion
